widgets_values: Wide shot, day time, side lighting, balanced composition. Goku, a muscular warrior with glowing spiky blonde hair and a torn orange martial arts gi, is engaged in a fierce physical battle with Cell, a tall biomechanical humanoid featuring a green and black spotted exoskeleton and a crown-like head. Goku lunges forward aggressively, twisting his torso to deliver a high-speed right punch. Cell firmly plants his feet on the ground and raises his thick green forearm to block the incoming strike. The physical impact sends shockwaves through the air, kicking up clouds of dust and small rocks around their feet. They are fighting in a barren rocky wasteland under a clear, deep blue sky. The wind blows fiercely across the terrain, making Goku's torn belt and clothing flap rapidly in the air.
Basketball dribble, swish of hoop, sneakers squeak on court, wind rustle, distant crowd cheer, ball bounce, playful laughter, energetic rhythm.
